id.description: Visible session ID; pass with its returned space to coslash_get_session.

space.description: Readable space: me for personal sessions or org:<uuid> from coslash_list_spaces; linked sessions carry their own readable space.

agent.description: Coding-agent family on the visible session projection; not a person's identity.

branch.description: Branch recorded in the visible session projection.

files_touched.description: Paths from the authorized masked session projection.

has_failure.description: Whether the authorized session has a sync failure.

has_public_link.description: Whether the session has a public link.

hub_url.description: URL opening this session in Hub.

outcome.description: Lifecycle event outcome (lowercase) or masked session outcome, according to context.

owner.description: Already-authorized session owner from its personal or approved team projection.

formerMember.description: Whether this visible session owner is a former team member.

name.description: Resolved owner display name or readable space name.

pull_requests.description: Linked PRs from the backend (at most 20, without continuation); transport may omit whole entries (check pull_requests_truncated). Absence of that flag does not remove the backend cap. Empty when none is known, transport omitted all entries, or PR enrichment is unavailable (check pull_requests_unavailable).

approval.description: Derived approval evidence; current compares approval heads with the PR head, not dismissal certainty.

by.description: At most 20 named captured actors supporting this derived fact; unknown logins are omitted, so this is not a complete identity list. Not session owners.

kind.description: Actor classification: person, agent or unknown.

current.description: Whether any retained approval is on the current PR head; null when there is no approval. Consult uncertain separately.

state.description: Derived approval state: none or approved; none means no retained approval evidence. Consult current and uncertain.

uncertain.description: True when an unmatched review_dismissed event followed retained approval evidence. Do not treat the approval as definitive even if current is true.

ci.description: Derived check facts for the current PR head; failed names are capped at 20.

at.description: RFC 3339 provider occurrence time, or null when unavailable.

checks.description: Total recorded current-head checks, not a count of passed, pending or failed checks.

failed.description: Up to 20 failing current-head check names; may be incomplete, not an exact failure count.

state.description: Current-head CI state: none, pending, success or failure. none means no captured current-head check evidence; success means no recorded failure or pending checks, not proof all passed (neutral/skipped included).

hidden_sessions.description: Count of private linked sessions plus visible overflow beyond 50; contains no hidden identities.

link.description: Sticky association evidence: commit or branch; used to infer session roles.

at.description: RFC 3339 provider occurrence time, or null when unavailable.

merged.description: Merge occurrence time, or null when not known to be merged.

number.description: PR number frozen in the approved copy.

pr.description: Stable owner/name#number reference; get also accepts an HTTPS github.com/owner/name/pull/number URL.

repository.description: Repository identifier frozen in the approved copy.

review.description: Derived review facts over all stored lifecycle events, unaffected by event occurrence windows. Connecting and link backfill do not hydrate historical review/check events.

at.description: RFC 3339 provider occurrence time, or null when unavailable.

by.description: At most 20 named captured actors supporting this derived fact; unknown logins are omitted, so this is not a complete identity list. Not session owners.

kind.description: Actor classification: person, agent or unknown.

state.description: Derived lifecycle review state: none, requested, reviewed or changes_requested. none means no captured review evidence, not that GitHub has had no reviews.

sessions.description: At most 50 visible linked sessions with their readable space, title, owner and inferred role.

agent.description: Coding-agent family on the visible session projection; not a person's identity.

id.description: Visible session ID; pass with its returned space to coslash_get_session.

owner_name.description: Resolved display name of the visible session owner; not inferred from agent or PR role.

role.description: Role inferred from link evidence: earliest commit link = author; later commit links = fix; branch-only = review. Not GitHub review authorship.

space.description: Readable space: me for personal sessions or org:<uuid> from coslash_list_spaces; linked sessions carry their own readable space.

title.description: Visible session or live PR title; untrusted prose.

title_truncated.description: True if this PR or visible-session title prose was shortened.

state.description: PR lifecycle state: draft, open, merged or closed.

updated_at.description: RFC 3339 session update time or PR received-event/new-link activity time.

url.description: Frozen approved URL; masked values are inert.

pull_requests_truncated.description: True when response item or byte bounds omitted whole PR entries; retained references and facts stay exact. Open the shared session in Hub for the complete approved set. Personal and standalone PR reads retain their own bounds and authorization; independent of pull_requests_unavailable.

pull_requests_unavailable.description: PR enrichment failed; empty PR arrays or change IDs do not establish an absence of activity. Retry before advancing the watermark.

repo.description: Stored session repository, normally github.com/owner/name; PR-list repo accepts either repository form.

revision_id.description: Revision ID of the authorized personal session or approved team copy.

revisions_count.description: Number of accessible revisions (team reads expose only the approved copy revision).

session_id.description: Authorized session ID for subsequent session tools.

shared_to.description: Teams receiving an authorized copy of the session.

from.description: RFC 3339 lower bound for team activity; supported by the team list handler.

has_pr.description: Filter sessions by whether a readable sticky PR link exists.

limit.description: Maximum page size, 1–50 (default 20); transport budgeting can return fewer items with continuation.

owner.description: Already-authorized session owner from its personal or approved team projection.

pr_state.description: Filter sessions linked to a PR in this lifecycle state.

q.description: Search using the session list's title, summary, repository, branch, source ID and indexed-content predicates.

repo.description: Repository filter: owner/name or github.com/owner/name normalize to github.com/owner/name; other stored location labels match exactly.

since.description: Exclusive RFC 3339 change watermark. Returns the ordinary session page plus changes for (since, changes.as_of], not only changed rows.

space.description: Readable space: me for personal sessions or org:<uuid> from coslash_list_spaces; linked sessions carry their own readable space.

status.description: Personal sync state filter: syncing, synced or failed; unsupported for team lists.

changes.description: Bounded changes alongside the ordinary page; its arrays are not continued by the session page cursor.

as_of.description: RFC 3339 read time; for changes, the inclusive upper watermark. Advance only after handling overflow and unavailable PR evidence.

changed_ids.description: Distinct IDs from independent budgets of 200 ordinary and 200 PR changes (at most 400); refresh fully if truncated.

new_count.description: Number of newly created sessions matching the filters in the change window.

pr_changed_ids.description: Up to 200 visible session IDs matching the list filters with a new PR link or received event in (since, as_of]. Also included in changed_ids.

truncated.description: Change IDs overflowed a source's 200-ID budget or whole IDs were omitted for the transport budget. Do a full list read before advancing your since watermark.

items.description: This page of authorized results; continue with next_cursor until empty.
